svg.title: Daily GPP, TER and NEE from 14 days before to 28 days after the last day of a silage harvest, all 20 used episodes of the four grass sites together, in g C m⁻² d⁻¹; mean and ± 1 SD over the episodes.
svg.desc: One panel. X axis: days from the last day of the harvest (−14 to +28, local days, UTC+2). Y axis: GPP, TER and NEE in g C m⁻² d⁻¹, from −8 to 14 (NEE < 0 = uptake, NEE = TER − GPP). Lines, all solid: GPP light blue with circles, TER light pink with squares, NEE steel blue with triangles; markers every 7 days. The band around each line is the mean ± 1 SD over the episodes; line and band are drawn only where 2 or more episodes have a value. An orange vertical line marks day 0 (the last day of the harvest), a thin line marks 0. All grass sites (n = 20; 19 to 20 episodes per day): change of days +1 to +14 against days −14 to −1 per episode, in g C m⁻² d⁻¹: ΔGPP −4.6 g C m⁻² d⁻¹ (SD 3.1, n 20), ΔTER −0.3 g C m⁻² d⁻¹ (SD 1.7, n 20), ΔNEE 4.2 g C m⁻² d⁻¹ (SD 2.9, n 20). Mean of the curve over days +1 to +14, in g C m⁻² d⁻¹: GPP 4.5, TER 5.0, NEE 0.5; days +15 to +28: GPP 6.4, TER 5.1, NEE −1.3.
